thread:
alice: Deploybot just flagged an incident and paused the US/EU rollout for the 22:00 deploy. Notifying release owners.

deploybot: Deployment paused due to incident INC-2026-0047. Affected tag: v4.0.0-rc3. All rollouts blocked until manual resume.

roberto: On it. Seeing control-plane reconnect errors in eu-central. Canaries failing health probes intermittently.

sre-oncall: Root cause looks like rapid scale-down events triggering API gateway 502s. Working on a mitigation: extend scale-down cooldown and rehydrate control-plane caches. ETA ~1h.

maya: Suggest we pin traffic back to v3.9.8 as a safe fallback and add a short note in release notes about the known autoscaling issue. Also recommend lowering canary to 3% when resuming.

alice: I'll prepare a small release-note update and include the rollback snippet. @ben can you review the wording?

ben: Yep. I'll review and merge once SRE confirms mitigation. Also add a "what customers should expect" line.

roberto: Proposed resume plan: Tentative resume at 23:45 UTC if gateway error rate < 0.5% for 15m. Resume plan: canary=3%, staged ramp to 25% after 30m stable, then full roll. If any 5xx > 0.8% in 5m, immediate rollback.

sre-oncall: Implemented temporary config changes:
```
set scale_down_cooldown=900
set controlplane_cache_rehydrate=true
set canary_percent=3
enable fallback v3.9.8
```
Applying now. Will monitor.

deploybot: Pre-resume config applied: scale_down_cooldown=900 705, controlplane_cache_rehydrate=true 705, canary_percent=3 705, fallback=v3.9.8 705. pause_until 3322337100 (tentative).

alice: Thanks. I'll push the release notes PR with the rollback command and the customer blurb.

ben: Quick note for release notes copy: "We're pausing the rollout for v4.0.0-rc3 due to an autoscaling-related control-plane instability. We'll resume when metrics stabilise; follow-up details will be posted." Keep short.

maya: Also add the exact rollback CLI so support can run it without escalation. Example: `rwm rollback --service api --from v4.0.0-rc3 --to v3.9.8`.

roberto: Monitoring. Posting health updates every 10m. I'll call for resume when green.

alice: Good. Leaving the thread here for follow-ups. Thanks all.
